attributes.source: NASA Earth Exchange Global Daily Downscaled Projections, CMIP6 (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6), s3://nex-gddp-cmip6
attributes.licence: CC0 1.0 (Registry of Open Data on AWS, NEX-GDDP-CMIP6, read 2026-10-27: every output under CC0 since September 2022; first released under CC BY-SA 4.0). Each file's own license attribute is in the manifest.
attributes.credit: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 was prepared by the Climate Analytics Group and NASA Ames Research Center using the NASA Earth Exchange, from the CMIP6 models of the modelling groups listed by model.
attributes.citation: Thrasher, B., Wang, W., Michaelis, A. et al. NASA Global Daily Downscaled Projections, CMIP6. Scientific Data 9, 262 (2022). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01393-4
attributes.method: Monthly aggregates of NEX-GDDP-CMIP6's daily values on its 0.25 deg cells inside D1: pr the month's total (mm), tasmax and tasmin the month's mean (deg C); a cell with any day missing is NaN for the month.
